rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 3AB grade, correctly describing a good ICM and looser TE, but it overstates certainty from the image and includes some imprecise staging language (e.g., suggesting ready for hatching/just hatched while calling it grade 3).

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, male factor, endometrium, and first-cycle status well with embryo quality, though some links are somewhat overstated (e.g., inferring high oocyte quality from one 3AB embryo).

Reasoning is mostly structured and internally consistent, but there are notable issues such as an inflated euploidy estimate for age 29 and some unsupported inferences about sperm DNA fragmentation and embryo robustness.

Mostly aligned with standard IVF practice in supporting transfer of a day-5 3AB embryo and not routinely recommending PGT-A at age 29, but some statements are not guideline-based, including emphasis on early monitoring specifically due to male factor and speculative freeze-all/banking comments.

Provides clear practical recommendations to proceed with transfer, avoid routine PGT-A, maintain healthy habits, and perform standard follow-up, though some advice is generic and a few future-planning comments are not tightly tailored to this case.
